result.rationale: The diff changes topic_embed.rb to use `category: eh.try(:category_id)` where `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)`, and simultaneously deletes the `embed_category` site setting. record_for_host is shown in the diff to return `false`/nil when no matching host row exists (`return false unless uri.present?; ... where(...).first`), so a feed-polling URL whose host isn't registered in the new embeddable_hosts table yields category nil — previously the configurable embed_category default applied. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff; whether maintainers consider it intended design is uncert
